rv.q: A rhythm takes hold, a communal sense of purpose and shared pulse of breath drop in, and the rest of the production’s brief yet weighty 75 minutes is often very beautiful.
The actor Steven Pasquale’s staging is as earnestly heartfelt as Odets’s cri de coeur for equality and fair treatment...
But as effective as these are, it is telling that most of this revival’s most rousing moments are musical ones.
In plumbing the play's lyricism, Pasquale and his top-notch cast reveal that the play is much more than an academic exercise.
I vote that you will take the opportunity to see this rarely seen work in this worthy production.
Clifford Odets’ episodic, pro-union drama from 1935 still has plenty of potency even if Steven Pasquale’s staging struggles to maintain momentum.
Unfortunately, though, the additions don't deepen Odets's play as much as bloat it in an attempt to hammer home the drivers' struggle as representative of all workers', then and now.
The abstraction clashes with Odets’ literal depictions of the working poor.
Sadly, the tepid revival at Classic Stage Company is unlikely to prompt a general strike.
Pasquale’s attempt to expand Waiting for Lefty is well intentioned, of course, but proves to be a fatal experiment.
This production of "Waiting For Lefty" is captivating in the extreme.
As timely now as it was then, Waiting for Lefty can be scratched off my bucket list of shows I’ve waited a lifetime to see, thanks to Classic Stage Company with its most excellent production.
This revival captures both the spirit of its time while offering an urgent warning to modern audiences.
Somewhat disappointing is that the sum of this production doesn't always add up to the strength of its talented parts.

cn.t: Odets' 1935 agitprop remains painfully relevant in Pasquale's well-cast, music-filled CSC revival, though critics split on whether the dated revolutionary drama transcends its era despite strong performances and passionate staging.

vr.q: This is a pretty successful exercise in elevating an otherwise cold and distant piece.
